   - LIBERO-Object: 10 pick-and-place tasks, each "pick up the [X] and place it in the basket"
   - HDF5 data format: data/demo_X/obs/agentview_rgb (T,128,128,3), data/demo_X/actions (T,7), 50 demos per task
